namespace CallbackSubtypes

abbrev Positive := { value : Nat // 0 < value }

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_probe_constructor_checkedPositive]
def checkedPositive (value : Nat) : Option Positive :=
  if bound : 0 < value then some ⟨value, bound⟩ else none

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_probe_source_callHost]
def callHost (callback : Positive → Positive) : Positive :=
  callback ⟨1, by decide⟩

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_closure_makeClosure]
def makeClosureProbeBody (value : Positive) : Positive := value

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_probe_source_makeClosure]
def makeClosure (_seed : Nat) : Positive → Positive := makeClosureProbeBody

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_probe_source_callHostMixed]
def callHostMixed (callback : Nat → Positive → Positive) : Positive :=
  callback 7 ⟨1, by decide⟩

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_closure_makeMixedClosure]
def makeMixedClosureProbeBody (_marker : Nat) (value : Positive) : Positive := value

@[noinline, export lb_callback_subtype_probe_source_makeMixedClosure]
def makeMixedClosure (_seed : Nat) : Nat → Positive → Positive := makeMixedClosureProbeBody

def callHostContainer
    (callback : Option Positive → Except String (Option Positive)) :
    Except String (Option Positive) :=
  callback none

def makeContainerClosure (_seed : Nat) : Array (Option Positive) → Option Positive :=
  fun _values => none

end CallbackSubtypes
